title: Viva Engage: richer shared message previews and a full conversation dialog
notes: claim 56: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
claim 57: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout details, licensing background and documented control gaps are supported. The risk rationale should not assert that the change introduces no new data source or action; Microsoft describes the user experience but does not give those assurances.
